OBSERVABLE: preload supervisor pid=%d attempts=%d base_delay=%d p0_timeout=%d timeout=%d
DISTINGUISHES: Active timeout and attempt policy configuration from defaults
NOTES: Establishes configured attempt timeout and P0 timeout values for the session

DISTINGUISHES: Attempt start timestamp and attempt index
NOTES: Marks start of monotonic attempt duration measurement

EMITTED_WHEN: Elapsed monotonic time reaches or exceeds active timeout threshold
DISTINGUISHES: Timeout expiry from internal child failures crashes and external cancellation; pre-P0 timeout vs overall timeout by seconds parameter
NOTES: Primary definitive observable of supervisor timeout expiry

EMITTED_WHEN: Child process terminated due to an unhandled signal
DISTINGUISHES: Signal termination from clean exit status
AMBIGUOUS_WITH: External SIGKILL vs supervisor SIGKILL (unless correlated with preceding timeout log)
NOTES: Reaped via waitpid; signal=9 following timeout log confirms supervisor kill

EMITTED_WHEN: Child process voluntarily exited with non-zero status
DISTINGUISHES: Child explicit failure or abort from timeout or crash
AMBIGUOUS_WITH: Specific internal failure stage if child uses non-distinct status code
NOTES: Confirms child executed to completion without timing out

DISTINGUISHES: Successful attempt completion from all failure modes
NOTES: Confirms all stages succeeded within timeout budget

OBSERVABLE: p0 oracle state dirty or uncertain; refusing unsafe retry
DISTINGUISHES: P0 oracle dirty abort from clean retryable failure

OBSERVABLE: stack writer ran; refusing retry on this boot
DISTINGUISHES: Terminal post-writer abort from pre-writer failure
NOTES: Enforces single-shot boot rule after stack modification

DISTINGUISHES: Retry budget exhaustion from early abort on dirty state
NOTES: Terminal supervisor failure message before exiting with code 1
Triggers dynamic supervisor timeout threshold expansion from 1200s to 2200s

DISTINGUISHES: P0 discovery completion from pre-P0 search phase
NOTES: Enables P0 offset caching for subsequent attempts if child later fails

OBSERVABLE: pipe-physrw-summary pid=%d done=%d root=%d kaslr=%d base=%016zx slide=%016zx
EMITTED_WHEN: Child completes CFI and privilege stage
DISTINGUISHES: Post-privilege stage completion from intermediate stages
NOTES: Emitted immediately prior to child returning 0

OBSERVABLE: waiting for boot allocator quiet window seconds=%lld uptime=%lld
EMITTED_WHEN: Supervisor starts while device uptime is under 120 seconds
DISTINGUISHES: Initial boot quiet wait from attempt execution
NOTES: Uses CLOCK_BOOTTIME to prevent early allocator noise

EMITTED_WHEN: Clean attempt failure occurs and attempt < max_attempts
DISTINGUISHES: Inter-attempt delay from child attempt duration
NOTES: Ensures 5s inter-attempt sleep is not attributed to child duration
